review_notes: Provider owns the unchanged 20-service assembly; consumer/context edges to its inferred service type are import type only. main mounts the separate provider around App after desktop bootstrap, and tests import the real provider path. Provider and other stateful roots remain automatic; neighboring/dependency module tests preserve boundaries.

Route static traversal follows imports only with a visited set. Scripts/Execution semantic forbiddenEntryKeys guard catches a reverse shell import regardless of hashed filename; existing route/per-asset numeric limits and forbidden heavy dependencies remain unchanged. Aggregate calibration remains the separately reviewed parent change.

Authoring uses the same real API context and request transport. Conditioned script saves retain their admitted ETag and receipt checks. Queued-copy whole-operation Promise sharing covers form/guard Save, late edits keep their guard, private source presence triggers explicit root clear payloads, and completion/empty duration is retained.

Canonical source resolution still precedes the backend 0s exception. It requires a real same-project QUEUED source, unstarted/unended state and same supported completion mode; the build fingerprint includes EndedAt. Lightweight capacity snapshots retain only exact derived feature identity, while present compiled scripts remain authoritative.

Portable scenario normalization changes only semantically default duration mode/empty shape hashing after owned cloning; non-default runtime/results/group SLA fields remain in the request. Dedicated durable claims CAS and bounded raw publication read remain composed alongside that normalization.

Optional private scenario source-admission capability remains separate from current public scenario behavior. Publication presence/hash and exact source project/incarnation/content revisions are private durable authority checked inside the transaction; no API consumer-hook extraction alters that authority.
